test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: In a race of 400 m, Bhim gave Saral a head start by 20 m at the start of the race. Saral took 48 seconds to complete the race. What was the speed (in m/s) of Bhim if Saral defeated Bhim by a margin of 2 seconds?
solution:
**Given:**

Head start given to Saral = 20 m

Distance of the race = 400 m

Time taken by Saral to complete the race = 48 seconds

Margin by which Saral defeated Bhim = 2 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by Bhim to complete the race (as Bhim loses the race) = Time taken by Saral + Margin

⇒ Time taken by Bhim to complete the race = 48 + 2

⇒ Time taken by Bhim to complete the race = 50 seconds

As, Distance covered by Bhim = 400 m

Speed of Bhim = 400/50 = 8 sec

**Hence, the Speed of Bhim is 8 m/s.**
